name: Scanner limit
meaning: A configured bound on token buffering, with errors requiring explicit inspection.

name: Domain validation

name: Duration

name: Cancellation signal
meaning: A cooperative indication that work should stop, not a forced interruption of arbitrary code.

name: Completion signal
meaning: An explicit synchronization event used to wait for concurrent work before observing its result.

name: Unbuffered channel
meaning: A typed communication channel whose sends synchronize directly with corresponding receives.

name: Channel close
meaning: A sender-owned announcement that no further values will be sent, while buffered values remain receivable.

name: Ready select case
meaning: A communication operation that can proceed immediately, not merely the first case written.

name: WaitGroup lifecycle
meaning: Registering tasks before launch, signaling each completion once and waiting before observing finished work.

name: Mutex-protected update
meaning: A complete shared-state operation performed while holding the same mutual-exclusion lock.

name: Typed atomic counter
meaning: An integer object with individually atomic update and observation operations.

name: Cancellation-aware lifetime

name: Handler contract
meaning: Responding to a request through the supplied writer with explicit status, headers and body.

name: Recorder-based handler test
meaning: An in-memory test of status, headers and body produced through ResponseWriter, without a listener.

name: Transport boundary
meaning: The replaceable HTTP transaction interface where request I/O and context handling are implemented.
